#+title: Fixed preparation jobs

The packaged coordinator accepts immutable input data for three operation kinds:
native, application and sdk. Nix owns realization; the pinned Foundry mechanism
owns durable job observations. The runtime product verifier and output writer
verify and publish results. A job receipt supplies no execution authority.

The Source client is artifact-jobs. Its coordinator comes from the fixed startup
configuration BL_PREPARATION_COORDINATOR. Requests cannot supply commands, tool
paths, environment maps or Nix expressions. Each request owns a private directory
and independent source/result roots; Nix shares identical realization work.

#+begin_src clojure
(def handle
  (jobs/submit! coordinator private-directory
    {"version" 1 "kind" "native" "request" immutable-native-request}))
(jobs/status! handle)
(jobs/events! handle 0 200)
(jobs/await! handle 60000)
#+end_src

An await deadline leaves the durable job running. Reopen the saved handle to
observe it from a new caller. await! uses one coordinator VM for its polling.
Machine JSON uses separate bounded files rather than progress output.

Cancellation requests a stop only after validating the exact request-specific
worker argv, PID start identity and named systemd service membership. Ambiguous
identity requires recovery and produces no signal. An interrupted operation
has an unknown in-flight outcome; cancellation removes no retained roots.
Recovery is scoped to one request and does not scan unrelated jobs.

Coordinator startup is independent of the target SDK under construction. The
SDK-family operation consumes a captured full engine store root and one product
name: sdk, compiler, dependencies or bl-drop. The fixed recipe reads the lock
and producer implementation from that immutable engine root.
